title: Jeremy Buendia Claims Men's Physique Victory at 2025 Sasquatch Pro
site_name: Generation Iron Fitness & Strength Sports Network
excerpt: The 2025 Sasquatch Pro took place over the weekend with multiple divisions in bodybuilding taking the stage.
content:
Here are the full results from the 2025 Sasquatch Pro!

The 2025 Sasquatch Pro took place on Saturday in Washington with plenty of starpower taking the stage across three divisions. In the end, winners punched their tickets to the 2025 Olympia, if not already qualified.

Jeremy Buendia was victorious in a deep Men’s Physique lineup. The former Olympia champion will look to make an impact one more time at the biggest show in the world. Missy Truscott also showed why she is one of the top competitors in the world with a dominant victory in Figure, qualifying for her first Olympia in the division.

The full results from the show have been announced. Below, check out the full breakdown, along with an official scorecard. 

2025 Sasquatch Pro: All Division Winners

  • Men’s Physique: Jeremy Buendia
  • Figure: Missy Truscott
  • Bikini: Adrianna Kaczmarek
